Great question! Here's how to set up and use your Eco Organic Mattress properly:
Unboxing & Setup Open it within 30 days — Your warranty requires the mattress to be opened within 30 days of delivery, so don't leave it in the box.
Step-by-step:
Open the shipping box at the top
Lay the box on its side and slide the mattress out
Carefully remove the outer wrap (Kraft paper or white plastic)
Unroll the mattress and place it on your bed frame, foundation, or platform bed
Carefully cut and remove the inner vacuum-seal layer — the mattress will immediately begin expanding
Expansion timeline:
Within 30 minutes: Close to full size and ready to sleep on
Within 3-5 hours: Full expansion (lift each corner and give it a gentle shake to help)
Within a few days: Any wrinkles will naturally smooth out
What to Expect the First Night It may feel firmer than expected — If you're coming from memory foam or a traditional spring mattress, your Avocado will feel different. Natural latex pushes back rather than sinking, which is actually a sign of proper spinal support. This is completely normal and intentional.
The break-in period is real — The wool and cotton layers will soften and compress naturally over the first 30 to 60 days. The mattress you sleep on tonight won't be the same one you're sleeping on in six weeks. Most people find it reaches optimal feel between 30 and 90 days.
Give it time — Most people need 60 to 90 days to fully adjust to a new mattress, so don't judge it in the first few nights.
You'll notice a fresh, natural scent when you first open it — that's normal and will dissipate quickly. There's no off-gassing like with synthetic mattresses.
